meta.title: Peak reminder
meta.description: Shows a status dot in the conversation header for the DeepSeek API price windows: red with a pulse during peak hours, amber in the 30 minutes before peak starts, and green during off-peak. Click the dot for a countdown, a 24-hour ribbon, and the off-peak schedule; a one-time toast announces the moment peak begins. Peak is 00:30–16:30 UTC and off-peak is 16:30–00:30 UTC, shown in your local time zone. Everything is computed from the local clock: the plugin sends no requests and reads no session data.
